plans.title: ASR text quality: corpus hotwords, cue sizing, and persisted provenance
notes: Operator request after the first quality review: corpus hotwords, cue sizing, persisted provenance.
Hotwords: DEFAULT_HOTWORDS (23 terms, each one measured mis-recognised or recurring) + BILI_ASR_HOTWORDS extras; sent as the model documents and recorded.
Cue sizing: post-pass moves boundary marks back, absorbs punctuation-only groups, merges cues <6 chars or <1 s under the 60-character ceiling.
Provenance: write_archive writes asr_* frontmatter keys and raw.json provenance; asr.provenance() supplies it without loading a checkpoint.
Live E2E on the same recording: cues 124 -> 94, cues <1 s 24 -> 0, fragment cues 11 -> 0, leading-mark cues 3 -> 0; 马鞍牌 -> 马恩牌, 智力豆包 -> 智利, 攻势 gained but 公式 remains once; 跟着苗红 unchanged.

reconcile_note: Snapshot contract fix 2026-09-28: an empty-string compass_ref was removed.
